official_model_execution: Unmodified official_reference/rlpyt/projects/tqpo/tqpo_model.py is imported and executed directly.
official_algorithm_port: GPU tensor interface in tqpo_agent.py. Model initialization/output, original process_returns targets/masks, and original loss gradients are numerically compared by test_tqpo_official.py.

official_executable_overrides.reason: initialize hardcodes pid_i=cost_penalty=.5; preserve executed setting

task_and_runtime_adaptations.environment: SimpleButton raw environment cost; no reward reflection
task_and_runtime_adaptations.sampling: GPU MJWarp 12 environments x 1000 finite-horizon steps gives official 12000 cells. Upstream CPU train_tqpo.py selects sampler B from CPU threads; equivalent T100 x B120 recurrent optimization retained.
task_and_runtime_adaptations.total_budget: 834 complete official batches = 10,008,000 physical training transitions. Official launch requests 5,000,000; user campaign requests nominal 10,000,000.
task_and_runtime_adaptations.evaluation: Independent common raw undiscounted cost>15 event and paired undiscounted/discounted reward+cost reporting; training gamma remains official .99.
task_and_runtime_adaptations.terminal_inputs: Train CpuResetCollector carries terminal raw action/reward into reset observation with h/c=0; eval CpuEvalCollector zeros action/reward and h/c at done. Original observation previous-cost lag retained.
